purpose: Obsolete file-sharing protocol for very old NAS devices.
recommendation: Disable unless you must access a device that only supports SMB1 (security improvement).

recommendation: Optional; disable if you never print to XPS.

purpose: Classic media player and some legacy media components.
recommendation: Keep: some older games and launchers rely on Windows Media components for video playback.

recommendation: Enable only if an old game asks for it.
